body:
Bound-ligand repair could lower its objective while collapsing a covalent bond, then automatically apply that geometry. This corrects the reproduced failure and adds independent bonded/planar-geometry acceptance before publication. Follow-up to #110 and PR #111.

Repair now derives consistent small-ring substituent sides from topology, uses matching acyclic cis/trans targets and angular strengths converted for native degree-based constraints. Fixed-only native work is omitted, moving-dependent MMFF interactions remain equivalent to the complete field, and the captured energy reference is explicit. Context skin checks retain a safe lookahead and rebuilt model metadata survives serialization.

For fixed environments, three consecutive accepted coordinate steps below 0.01 Å after at least 25 accepted steps can stop as a **warned improvement** after geometry checks; only the independent force threshold establishes convergence. Isolated-molecule stopping behavior is preserved. Declared fully unsaturated small rings must pass an independent planarity guard; saturated rings retain their puckering. Historical quick proposals without bonded and planar validation require rerun.

Implemented: correction, scientific regressions, full/partial native-force equivalence, fixed-row preservation, damaged metal-linked repair regressions, and native controls/accessibility/timing verification. Simplified: omit fixed-only objective constants and disclose the reference. Deferred: qualified metal/cofactor/covalent-adduct physics remains outside this quick profile; unsupported connected groups remain explicitly approximate. Rejected: applying lower-energy collapsed geometry or presenting geometry settling as force convergence.

Evidence is under docs/assets/quick-minimization/c5-candidate-10-*. Focused checks pass 56 Python, 313 frontend, 26 repeated native browser cases / 10 documented exclusions, zero failures/flakes/retries. Private read-only replay is summarized without publishing project data. All five versions remain 0.23.0; no dependency or database migration change. Complete exact-master qualification is required before the annotated tag and release.
